verdict.rationale: Bevy is not a separate scripting language but 'just a normal Rust dependency' using 'normal Rust datatypes' for components/systems (bevy-docs-20, bevy-docs-21, bevy-docs-14, bevy-docs-42), implying standard Rust tooling (which includes typed definitions an editor could attach to) works out of the box rather than requiring bespoke Bevy tooling. However, there is no explicit mention of an official language server, IDE plugin, or typed API/schema documentation tailored for coding-agent editor integration. missing for 10: explicit mention of rust-analyzer/LSP support, dedicated typed API schema or completions/diagnostics tooling, independent confirmation of editor navigation support.
